title: What's New in Manufacturing: Order Processing (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction to usability improvements in production order handling
Bulk status changes and production order movement
Scheduling, safety lead time, and attachments in production orders
Business posting groups, component availability, and routing enhancements
Item tracking in consumption and output journals with Excel support
Barcode label printing for tracked items and summary

features.name: Ability to block output transactions
features.description: Added capability to block output transactions in production order handling.

features.name: Bulk status change for production orders
features.description: Production orders can be bulk moved between statuses. Select all and use change status functionality.
caveats: Most are converted. The rest need analysis and action.

features.name: Safety lead time buffer in production orders
features.description: The production order includes a buffer between the due date and end date based on safety lead time in a manufacturing setup or item card.
caveats: Manual scheduling field must be activated on the manufacturing setup page.

features.name: Rescheduling production orders without changing due date
features.description: Orders can be rescheduled without changing the due date. Moving the end date beyond the due date will prompt a confirmation.

features.name: Attachments in production order headers and lines
features.description: Attachments are now included in headers and production order lines automatically populated with information about items, bills of material, and routing.

features.name: Default business posting group in production orders
features.description: The business posting group code in the production order can be defaulted to the value defined in the default general business posting group field on the manufacturing setup page.

features.name: Improved component availability information
features.description: Availability information for components is improved. Select items can be used to add additional items.

features.name: Enhanced routing overview and link code updates
features.description: An overview of activities and routings is enhanced. Routing link code can also be updated within routings affecting the start date for connected components.

features.name: Item tracking in consumption and output journals
features.description: Consumption and output journals now feature tracking and lines like the item journal. Edit in Excel capability can be utilized to populate item tracking details.

features.name: Barcode label printing for tracked items
features.description: Barcode labels can be printed for items with tracking from both released and finished production orders.

quotes.text: Productivity increases when processes are easy. So we improved usability in the different areas within production order handling.
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets the theme of the release focusing on usability improvements rather than new major functionality.

quotes.text: Production orders can be bulk moved between statuses. Select all and use change status.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates a new bulk operation capability that reduces manual effort in production order management.

quotes.text: The production order includes a buffer between the due date and end date based on safety lead time in a manufacturing setup or item
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the new safety lead time buffer mechanism and where it is configured.

quotes.text: Attachments are now included in headers and production order lines automatically populated with information about items, bills of material, and routing.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights automatic population of contextual information in attachments, improving data consistency.

quotes.text: Routing link code can also be updated within routings affecting the start date for connected components.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows how routing updates now have cascading effects on component scheduling.

quotes.text: Consumption and output journals now feature tracking and lines like the item journal.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains that production journals now support item tracking similar to standard inventory functionality.
